lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: You cross into the shadow-ground. Either you do not know what this means, or you do not care. We respect both possibilities equally.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: We have observed you from a distance, Alien. Your movements are not those of a creature seeking death. And yet here you are. Interesting.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: You have fought our kin and not fallen. This is noted.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: This is... significant.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: Do not mistake our stillness for hesitation. We are simply appreciating the moment before it begins.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: Another approaches. Mars provides.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: You fight without rage. This is strange to us. And yet the result does not lie.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: We have encountered many who claim capability they do not possess.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: You are unusual in the opposite way.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: The 'Life-Giver' does not ask us to hate our opponents. Only to meet them fully.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: To hold back is to disrespect both Mars and the one who stands before you.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: We do not fear death.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: We fear a death that meant nothing. A death with no witness.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: A death that Mars does not record.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: The 'Battle-Crave' is not anger. Anger is a wound. The 'Battle-Crave' is a calling. There is a difference.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: We do not understand the ones who live in the green places. They avoid conflict at great cost to themselves.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: To us this looks like a slow defeat they call peace.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: You are still here.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: Mars watches.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: Come back when the 'Battle-Crave' takes you. We will be here.

lines.speaker: Son of Mars
lines.text: The shadow-ground is ours. You are a guest. Do not forget the difference.
